The move of the scan complete notification handling to the wiphy worker
introduced a race between scan complete notification and scan abort:
- The wiphy lock is held
- Scan complete notification is received but not handled yet.
- Scan abort is triggered
column2: and scan abort is sent to the FW. Once the

column1: scan abort command is sent successfully
for the scan complete notification. However
notification was already received but not processed yet
a second and continues leaving the scan status in an inconsistent
state.
- Once scan complete handling is started (when the wiphy lock is not held)
since the scan status is not an inconsistent state
and the scan complete notification is not handled.
To fix this issue
column2: switch back the scan complete notification to be

column1: asynchronously handling
column2: and only move the link selection logic to

column1: a worker (which was the original reason for the move to use wiphy lock).
